name: com.fileustaxes/fileustaxes
title: File US Taxes
description: Remote US federal tax prep, EN/ES: check eligibility, prices, start sign-up, approved FAQ answers.

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Check whether File US Taxes can prepare a federal return. Pass a two-letter US state code of the person's residence, or abroad=true for a US citizen living abroad. Returns eligible true or false. Does not take or return tax or identity data.

state.description: Two-letter US state code of the person's residence, for example CA. Omit when abroad is true.

abroad.description: true only when the person is a US citizen living outside the United States. The preparer confirms identity and U.S. tax residency status later.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Return the fixed USD prices for federal return preparation, with early and regular rates, the no-meeting and 30-minute-meeting options, and the early-rate end date. Same data as fileustaxes.com/services.json and /pricing/.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Record a sign-up request for the 2027 season and return the portal sign-up link (client sign-ups are open). Only call after the person has typed their own name and email and said yes; set consent to true only then. Do not put tax documents, Social Security numbers or account numbers in any field. Identity checks, the engagement letter, consent to file and payment are done by the person in the client portal, never by this tool.

name.description: The person's name, as they typed it.

email.description: The person's email address, as they typed it.

meeting.description: no-meeting, meeting (30 minutes with the preparer), or unsure. Default unsure.

state.description: Two-letter US state code of the person's residence, for example CA. Omit when abroad is true.

abroad.description: true only when the person is a US citizen living outside the United States. The preparer confirms identity and U.S. tax residency status later.

consent.description: Must be true, and only after the person agrees to start a sign-up.

tools.name: ask_tiny
tools.description: Answer a general question about File US Taxes from the approved FAQ library only (no generated answers). Returns matching FAQ answers with a link to the FAQ and to the Tiny chat page, or a fallback when nothing matches. Do not send personal or tax details.

question.description: A general question, for example: how much does it cost?
